She is a member of the Whitney Museum Council and attends their programming regularly alongside her museum involvement. Sarah Okafor manages the relationship; Sunita gives at the mid-tier level. Proposed next step: introduce her to the director over a private lunch and discuss a potential major gift toward the photography endowment.

provenance_exclusions.question: Which donor works in Lazard restructuring and is being cultivated around an exhibition on Chinese American artistic identity?

excluded_gold.name: Victoria Huang
excluded_gold.content: Victoria Huang is a managing director at Lazard's restructuring advisory group, where she has worked for sixteen years following stints at Merrill Lynch and a boutique restructuring firm. She holds an undergraduate degree from Dartmouth and a JD/MBA joint degree from NYU. Victoria lives in the West Village with her husband and twin sons and has been a museum supporter for nine years. Her collecting interest centers on contemporary Chinese American artists — she owns significant works by Hung Liu and Martin Wong, and has been following the career of Wangechi Mutu's generation of artists closely. She attended Art Basel Hong Kong twice as a collector and is a member of the advisory board for Asian Arts at the Brooklyn Museum. Diana Flores manages the relationship and is cultivating a major gift conversation tied to a proposed exhibition on Chinese American artistic identity in New York. Victoria expressed strong enthusiasm at a recent cultivation dinner.
